premise: A rainy day makes Mouse glum, so Raccoon plays peekaboo and Frog does a backflip, and a rainbow comes to watch the show.
inspiration: The Grimm tale of the princess who could not laugh, made small and kind: friends put on a show until the glum one giggles, and the sky joins in.
lesson: Friends can turn a grey day bright.

en-US.title: The Rainy Day Show
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 24s} {sfx:rain-bed} Drip, drop. It rained all morning. Mouse {mouse:pulse} sat under a leaf with a long face. [sad] Nothing to do, he sighed. Raccoon {raccoon:hop} bounced over. [excited] Time for a show! Watch this! {raccoon:live} He rubbed his paws, covered his eyes, peeked out… and BOO! Mouse's whiskers {mouse:wobble} twitched. Almost a smile. Then Frog {frog:pulse} jumped onto her lily pad. My turn! {frog:live} She sprang up, flipped over backwards, landed with a {sfx:splash} splash, and snap! caught a fly. [laughs] Mouse laughed so hard he tumbled {mouse:spin} right into a puddle. And guess who else came to watch? {canvas:rainbow 0.9 16s} [gasps] A rainbow, stretched right across the sky! [happily] The best rainy day ever, said Mouse. {mouse:hearts} {raccoon:hearts} {frog:hearts}

es-ES.title: El espectáculo del día de lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 24s} {sfx:rain-bed} Plic, ploc. Llovió toda la mañana. Ratón {mouse:pulse} estaba debajo de una hoja, con cara larga. [sad] No hay nada que hacer, suspiró. Mapache {raccoon:hop} llegó dando saltitos. [excited] ¡Hora del espectáculo! ¡Mira esto! {raccoon:live} Se frotó las patitas, se tapó los ojos, asomó… ¡y CUCÚ-TRAS! Los bigotes de Ratón {mouse:wobble} se movieron. Casi una sonrisa. Luego Rana {frog:pulse} saltó a su hoja de nenúfar. ¡Me toca! {frog:live} Dio un brinco, una voltereta hacia atrás, cayó con un {sfx:splash} chapuzón, y ¡zas!, atrapó una mosca. [laughs] Ratón se rio tanto que se cayó {mouse:spin} en un charco. ¿Y sabéis quién más vino a verlo? {canvas:rainbow 0.9 16s} [gasps] ¡Un arcoíris, de punta a punta del cielo! [happily] El mejor día de lluvia del mundo, dijo Ratón. {mouse:hearts} {raccoon:hearts} {frog:hearts}

rain-bed.prompt: steady light rain on leaves and a small pond

splash.prompt: a small frog landing on a lily pad with a light water splash
